name: Youth Explore Trades Sampler (Vancouver School Board)
what_you_do: Try several skilled trades in one semester. Try carpentry, electrical work, plumbing, iron work and sheet metal. Find the one that fits you.
who_can_apply: Vancouver School Board students who are Canadian citizens or permanent residents. Apply in grade 11 for grade 12, semester 2, at John Oliver Secondary. Grade 12 students can apply if a spot is left.
pay_detail: VSB pays tuition. You pay about $500 for supplies, tools and safety gear.
deadline_text: The form and flyer say to apply by March 1, with no year. The flyer is from Nov 2025. Ask your counsellor.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application on the page. Give it to your counsellor, who sends it in. You also need references, grad reports and a resume. Email careerprograms@vsb.bc.ca.
notes: Pages differ. The program page says you must be in grade 11, and also that grade 12 can apply if a space remains. The flyer says grade 10 or 11. The form says going into grade 11 or 12. The page says John Oliver Secondary; the form lists BCIT campuses. Confirm with the school. The form asks for a Social Insurance Number, so ask the school about it first. Contact Mark Reid, Career Programs Teacher, mreid@vsb.bc.ca.
